# Börsen mot tydliga nedgångar – experterna summerar veckan

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The EFN Morgon episode opened as global stocks fell broadly after Anthropic's record-breaking IPO. Wall Street was heading for its worst week since the April 2025 tariff chaos, Asia fell hard, and Stockholm was set to drop more than 1%. The SEB guest and the Montrose guest stayed constructive, describing the move as a correction and a rotation into defensives such as Axfood, Telia, Tele2 and Essity rather than a washout. Risks they named were Fed tightening, AI capex uncertainty and wider credit spreads. In the weekly wrap, Nvidia was called a buy for anyone who wants AI exposure, Anthropic was called speculation, they were skeptical of Klarna, positive on Coor's Norwegian acquisition and on FM Mattsson, and they laid out a value range for trading the SKF auto spin-off.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Blowout report, raised guidance, buybacks; P/E about 8-9 after the CEO-scandal selloff; host calls it a buying opportunity for AI exposure

#### Reasoning

Host (Peter/Martin) says the fundamentals are intact: full order books it cannot fill, the heart of the AI economy, China only 7% of sales. After the 14% drop on the CEO exit the valuation looks very cheap at about P/E 8 next year. They note AI uncertainty may justify a higher risk premium.

#### Sell Triggers

- further revelations around the CEO scandal
- tighter China export restrictions or gray-market sales exposed
- AI capex cycle slowing

> *"om man ska ändå ha någonting investerat där tycker jag Navid är ett av de bättre spelen"*

---

### ⛔ ANT — Anthropic | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

17x revenue, loss-making, founders control votes, philanthropic structure; host calls it speculation, not investment

#### Reasoning

Host argues the share structure gives outside shareholders no real influence and a weak profit incentive (5% of the company to a charity). The valuation is sky-high with no profits, though revenue grew 47% quarter on quarter and inference gross margin is 85%. Where the AI economy lands is impossible to know.

> *"Så det här är ju spekulation snarare än investering."*

---

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest Niklas Andersson: a defensive grocer that could benefit while uncertainty is high; highly valued, low beta

#### Reasoning

Guest (Montrose) sees Axfood as a hiding place during the rotation from cyclicals to defensives: predictable, steadily improving, and it has underperformed recently. It already carries a valuation premium.

#### Sell Triggers

- risk-on rotation back into cyclicals
- valuation premium widening further

> *"Men det skulle kunna vara en som gynnas då när osäkerheten är hög."*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

JP Morgan cut to neutral; guest very skeptical of the new business model despite strong network effects

#### Reasoning

Guest Niklas Andersson says Hemnet has made many changes in a short time and he is very skeptical of the new business model. The cited JP Morgan downgrade to neutral from overweight sent the stock down 4%.

> *"Jag är väldigt skeptisk till deras nya affärsmodell."*

---

### ⛔ KLAR — Klarna | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Weak scalability, opex up about 20%, late payments rising in fair financing, US credit risk; host skeptical

#### Reasoning

Host is skeptical: GMV grew about 10% but profit barely rose, costs are outpacing revenue, and share programs dilute. Sold receivables hide credit losses, and late payments rose to 3.5-3.7%. Europe is flat, so growth depends on a weak US consumer.

> *"Jag är lite skeptisk. Man säger att tillväxten bromsar in."*

---

### 🟢 COOR — Coor | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Insider Group bought at 5.4x EBITDA incl. synergies, about 25% EPS accretion; host thinks the market under-rewarded it; in the dividend portfolio

#### Reasoning

Host says the acquisition looks cheap and adds Norwegian density for cost and sales synergies. It restarts acquisition-led growth after deleveraging. The stock rose only 5-6%, which the host thinks is too little. It is held in their dividend portfolio for stability.

#### Sell Triggers

- synergies of 40 MSEK not realised
- leverage rising again
- deal not completing

> *"Men på rent fundamenta på det här förvärvet så tycker jag att de borde få ännu bättre betalt."*

---

### 🟢 FMM-B — FM Mattsson | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Keeps delivering on growth and margin, Bristan deal; not cheap anymore but host sees more upside

#### Reasoning

Host notes improved growth and margins and the large UK Bristan acquisition, defying weak consumer-discretionary peers. The valuation is no longer cheap, but own initiatives plus the deal leave more upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- margins rolling back from near pandemic-peak levels
- Bristan integration problems
- weaker renovation market

> *"så landar jag ändå i att det finns mer, mer kvar i kranarna"*

---

### 🟠 SKF-B — SKF (Atevo spin-off) | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Atevo fair range 75-110 SEK; buy near 75, sell near 110; starts trading 1 Dec; SKF expected to drop about 7-8% ex-rights

#### Reasoning

Host values Atevo at 7x EV/EBIT, about 15-22 SEK per SKF share (75-110 SEK after the 1:5 ratio). Funds that do not want a small auto supplier may sell, so trading could be messy, which is a special-situation opportunity: act only if the price is outside the range.

#### Sell Triggers

- Atevo trades near or above 110 SEK
- 6% margin target looks unreachable

> *"om den hamnar i den under delen av det här, vilket ju blir 75 kronor när man tar det gånger 5, då tycker jag att den här kanske börjar bli lite för billig"*

---

### ⛔ EPIS-B — Episurf | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Real-estate acquisitions paid with warrants and convertibles; heavy dilution coming; quality impossible to judge yet

#### Reasoning

Host Peter suspects poor-quality properties are being funneled in, paid for with dilutive instruments. Many new shares will come out, so it is best to wait until things settle before judging quality.

> *"jag misstänker att rätt mycket dåliga fastigheter slussas iväg här"*

---
